Recent reviews
James Jeffrey Culpepper

With a bad knee I was unable to mow my own grass this season. Rob at home gnome showed up every week and did an excellent job. I’m a little bit picky about the way the grass gets mowed, trimmed and blown off, but Rob exceeded my expectations. I’m very pleased with the service of Rob from Tater’s Lawn Care who took care of my yard through the Home Gnome interface. I was on vacation for a couple of weeks this summer and it was so nice to know that the yard continued to be maintained while I was gone. Only good things to say about Rob and Home Gnome. He always edged the walkways and trimmed around the fence posts and poles, and the cutting pattern always looked good. If the weather was wet or too hot, I would get a message that they were rescheduling and then he would show up on the day that he had rescheduled for so they are dependable and consistent and reliable. Very pleased with the service I received from Rob and HomeGnome.

Home Gnome

homegnome.com

Shane

It was first live food transaction for my Brazilian Giant White Knee tarantula (sling), as great as ordering & delivery was great, but I had no clue exactly what I was buying lol 😂 I was trying to get micro brown crickets but instead I ordered pinhead tiny baby crickets, but as I was surfing the website of Reptiles by Post website they have some awesome set ups.. The one thing I will remember next time I order as well is to make sure that the parcel doesn't get left on my doorstep in pouring rain!!! & Cold. Most of the cricket's were dead on arrival but some did survive, so I gut fed them got them as big as I could & just gave them to my spider for a snack until I get the right feed. My era not the shops I should of read about the delivery schedule & right size feed for my sling, oh well I got some more pets lol 😂 Thanks Reptile by Post🙏🙏🙏

Reptiles By Post

reptilesbypost.com

Lakshay Sharma

Fast, efficient, and professional service from Akshay B! I recently reached out via live chat because my account hadn't reflected my upgrade from the monthly plan to the annual SMV2-VZ plan. Akshay B handled my query exceptionally well and with great speed. After a quick and secure verification process using my support PIN, Akshay promptly identified the payment, updated my billing cycle and due date, and seamlessly escalated the ticket to the technical team for the server upgrade. The entire interaction was smooth, polite, and resolved in just a few minutes. Excellent customer support—thank you, Akshay B!

Host.co.in

host.co.in

Queralt Artacho Valls

An incredible experience! Without a doubt, a highly recommended travel agency. Everything was perfectly organized from start to finish, with friendly, professional service and great attention to every detail. The tours were very well organized, the guides were fantastic, and every moment of the trip exceeded our expectations. Everything went perfectly, and we enjoyed every minute of it. I would definitely book with them again without hesitation! Thank you for making this trip such an unforgettable experience. 10 out of 10! 🌍✈️

Rootwavetravels

rootwavetravels.com

swaran lata Safaya

Extremely disappointing experience with KAFF! Their customer service is pathetic. They take bookings for servicing but fail to show up, and there is absolutely no accountability or response. Customers are left chasing them despite paying for their products and services. Such poor after-sales service is unacceptable. KAFF needs to understand that customer satisfaction doesn’t end with selling a product. I would strongly caution others to think twice before choosing this brand.

kaff.in

www.kaff.in

Shop Online

Update to my previous review: Despite returning the bag, JRL London has kept both the item and my money, refusing to issue a refund or offer an exchange. This is absolutely unacceptable and feels clearly like outright theft. Customer service has been completely ineffective, with no proper communication or willingness to resolve the matter. An extremely disappointing experience.

JLR London

jlr-london.com

Joanne Murphy

It has taken forever to obtain a response to our claim -- in fact, I still do not have an answer. Our family was ill on the day we were scheduled to attend a show at Walnut Street Theatre. Never had so many questions about why we did not attend, requested doctor's note (which we do not have). Still waiting for response and my refund!

Allianz Partners USA

www.allianztravelinsurance.com

liliana savarioxenreider

My pets food is under vet prescription and I found in this site all what their doctor recomndated...this site gave me over 4 years all what I needed and I am greatful to find in one place all what i need for my furry friends to make them happy! Quality...excellent customer service...right in time...

zooplus.ro

zooplus.ro

my experience wads not great i tried to create an account as an affiliate from nigeria but i got error code REG04 saying that can accept customers from nigeria for tax reason i wish they told this from begging before i wasting time filling form i hope they will allow nigeria soon

The quick response from the ALT team was AWESOME! I explained how I received my perfume and provided pictures and they are making it right by replacing it with another bottle. The ALT team’s pride in doing what is right and customer satisfaction is why I will continue to shop with them.

ALT. Fragrances

altfragrances.com

Amazing experience for me and my partner at Drift Limits, we took part in drifting MX5's where Adam was an amazing and funny instructor. My partner also drove the R34 and Porsche GT2 and he said George was a massive help and thought he did an amazing job! We will 100% be coming back!

DRIFT LIMITS

www.driftlimits.co.uk

Paula Butterworth

6th year running to get my Scouse Bird Diary and I think this years pink and red striped one is my fave so far. Menopausal brain fog is brutal and so this diary helps me attempt to keep my life in order. Always great communication about orders….Long Live Scouse Bird 🙌🙌🙌. Xx

Scouse Bird Shop

scousebirdshop.com

Angie Amphithea Svensen

If you can’t avoid using these company, then do so They do not have Human representatives And their online chat is horrible as it deletes all previous chats and you have to write all the details about yourself and your policy again every time you return to the chat

Melissa was very helpful after i had a hard time with a prior person, i don’t like the fact that you have to do subscriptions. I like to order when i aam able to , i wil faithfully try this magic product and give another review. The 5 star is for Melissa !

Excellent experience and highly recommended! My experience with this company was wonderful. The service was fast and very professional, and the support team was extremely helpful and polite. I am fully satisfied and strongly recommend them to everyone.
